remarks: Welcome to Stonebrook, one of Stamford's most sought-after complex This 3 Bedroom standalone condo offers the perfect blend of single-family living with the ease of condominium lifestyle. Ideally situated within the complex this home features a spacious and inviting open layout designed for comfortable living. The dramatic living room showcases cathedral ceilings and a Palladian window filling the space with light and creating an open, airy feel. The heart of the home is the kitchen and family room combination perfect for everyday living. The Family Room features a cozy gas fireplace and french doors opening to large private deck - ideal for outdoor dining and relaxing in a peaceful setting. Hardwood floors on both the first and second floors. Second floor offers generously sized bedrooms, including a comfortable primary suite with walk in shower and walk-in closet. Two more bedrooms complete the second floor with full bath in hallway with tub and shower. Additional highlights include a one car garage, c/a, gas heat, attic storage, low common charges and beautifully maintained grounds. Conveniently located just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, Golf Course, Shopping, Restaurants, Schools, Health Facilities. A rare opportunity to enjoy privacy, comfort and convenience in highly desirable Stamford location.
